q1_issues.issue: The subject "This" gets no witness and no class atom and nothing is predicated of it, so the sentence's entire copular claim is absent — the instruction set makes the witness plus its class atom mandatory for an antecedent-less pronoun and bars an untyped referent.
"one of the greatest mysteries" is reduced to a lone mystery witness: the definite superset of mysteries, the membership link from the subject, and the superlative "greatest" are all unencoded.
"in ALL of science" drops the universal — the atom records only the bare domain.

q2_gaps: copular "X is one of the ADJ-est Ns" — membership in a superlative-restricted definite set: Most/Ordinal encode a unique single-entity superlative, and the partitive machinery is written for a quantified subject or object, not for a copular predicate naming the set the subject belongs to
emphatic universal over a mass/domain noun ("all of science") — the quantifier-to-strength route and the partitive route both need a count range or a predication to attach to
notes: The one head used, In, is the licensed framing/domain oblique. What is emitted is not false, it is a small fragment of the sentence.
